title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode7 Because You Were All There

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Episode: Episode7 — Because You Were All There
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Hurry, Mommy!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, yes.
Let's find the back of the line.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Are we at the fishies yet?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
We should be soon.
While we wait, why don't we play a word game?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you smiling at?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just can't help but feel happy watching that family enjoy the fish coaster together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really become a popular ride.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's wonderful to see that it has since it was originally slated to be scrapped...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I mean, look at all the people lining up to go on it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we were able to save Grandpa's park...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Back then, I was totally convinced that it wouldn't be possible.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The Trampoline Dome, the haunted house, the merry-go-round... All of it was gonna be gone, but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa said so himself that time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless of operations and visitor totals, everyone that comes here wants to smile!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means there has to be a way for us to reach thousands of people all at once and make them smile!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If Tsukasa hadn't said that, I probably wouldn't have seen those kids smiling just now.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. More people began to visit after we put on more and more shows at the Wonder Stage... However, lately, something seems different about the park, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe we have our ambassadorial performances to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It wasn't just Tsukasa. Everyone helped save Phoenix Wonderland and return it to what it was like when Grandpa was still around—a park that's full of smiles.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
My dream came true because of them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means, I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: S-Sorry, I...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The truth is...
This weird feeling's been lingering inside me ever since Tsukasa began attending that workshop.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He kept getting better and better at acting, which made me really happy. I wanted to cheer him on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When Tsukasa said that he wanted to perform elsewhere in order to make his dream come true, a part of me started to believe that we'd have to say goodbye to each other soon...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was when I began hesitating...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But I understand now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys invited me to hang out with you and see the park to show me the smiles on all our guests' faces.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My dream of seeing Phoenix Wonderland become filled with smiles is within grasp.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And you guys helped make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, now it's my turn!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Since you all encouraged me to achieve my dream, I want to support you guys too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I really don't want us to split up...
That's probably never gonna change.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I want to show my support to Tsukasa, and you guys too, as you all reach for your goals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for telling us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, having to split up is sad...
That feeling's also been lingering inside me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me too.
I even sort of saw a clear vision the other day how that may actually happen in the future...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Which made me...
Well, feel the same way as you both.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I arrived at the same conclusion as you two.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it is sad that we're eventually going to have to go our separate ways, but I still want to be supportive of you all as you achieve your dreams.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I've been thinking of a way to deal with both...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Both? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, excuse me. That part only involves me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I'm glad to see that you're feeling better, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel a lot better now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, moving forward, I'm gonna sit front and center as I cheer you guys on!
song00006_off_f

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
I'm really glad you're all better now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You really do look your best when there's a smile on your face, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I think so too!
I'm so glad that you're feeling better now!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... Is that why you invited me here today? You guys were all worried about me...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, a little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We noticed that you seemed a little out of sorts lately. We told the others, and Len came up with the idea of inviting you to hang out as a way to cheer you up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to make you guys feel so concerned...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And thank you, Len!
I feel all better now because of you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Glad to hear it!
I mean, seeing you frowning also made me kinda sad!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad this went so well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me too.
However, it was also a reminder...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: About us... Our futures...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our futures...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and I want to become actors, and Rui a director. Eventually, we're all gonna have to say goodbye to the Wonder Stage to pursue our goals.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Unfortunately, when that happens...
Emu's gonna be so...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We've been here for quite a while now. When is Tsukasa's show supposed to start?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we should get going since he said that it's free seating...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We've gotta grab some spots where we can see him really well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, let's go see Tsukasa's big performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
